items.title: The henselization of a local ring is a filtered colimit over elementary etale neighbourhoods
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the henselization of the local ring at a point with the colimit of the rings of sections over the filtered category opposite to the elementary etale neighbourhoods of the point. The proof compares the two constructions, uses the description of the elementary etale neighbourhoods as a filtered system, and verifies that the colimit has the defining property of the henselization. Identifying the colimit with the henselization is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 10226-10240.
